text_block_list.text:
After the holidays, Narita Taishin came to 
the Trainer's Office.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Like that has anything to do with 
you... actually, it does.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Nothing special, just the usual. I had a 
normal break and got to take it easy.

It looks like Narita Taishin was able to 
get some proper rest.
